---
title: "Fit MOSK GP to 2-band synthetic example"
format: 
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

This notebook contains the workflow for:

- loading groundtruth 2-band (MOGP) time-series, 
- fitting a MOSK GP model, 
- checking which posterior draws produce valid covariance matrices, and 
- visualing the posteriors of the valid draws.

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
library(readr)
library(glue)
library(tictoc)

register_knitr_engine(override = FALSE)

theme_set(theme_bw())
color_scheme_set("viridis") # bayesplot

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))

filename_stub <- "D2-Q1-seed2777-n300-mnar0.3-noise0.05"

EXECUTE_SAMPLING <- TRUE
# SAMPLING_SEED <- ifelse(EXECUTE_SAMPLING, round(runif(n = 1, 0, 999)), 119)

N_CHAINS <- 4
N_WARMUP <- 500
N_SAMPLES <- 500

# Function estimates the mode of a sample
estimate_mode <- function(x) {
  d <- density(x, n = 2^6)
  d$x[which.max(d$y)]
}
```

```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 1

input_df <- read_csv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-sim.csv")), 
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_params <- read_tsv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-param.tsv")), 
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = y + y_se, ymin = y - y_se), colour = "black") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(colour = "Band")

ns <- table(input_df$d)
```

```{r}
input_params
```

# Model Fitting

```{r}
stan_model <- cmdstan_model(here("stan", "mosmgp-D2-Q1.stan"))
```
## Sampling

```{r}
band1_df <- filter(input_df, d == 1)
band2_df <- filter(input_df, d == 2)

data_list <- list(
  N1 = length(band1_df$t),
  N2 = length(band2_df$t),
  t1 = band1_df$t,
  t2 = band2_df$t,
  y1 = band1_df$y,
  y2 = band2_df$y,
  y1_se = band1_df$y_se,
  y2_se = band2_df$y_se
)
```

```{r}
format(start_time <- Sys.time())

if (EXECUTE_SAMPLING) {
  init_fun <- function() {
    init =   list(
      w = c(1.1, 1.6),
      mu = c(1.9, 2.3),
      Sigma = c(0.9, 1.1),
      theta2 = 0.1,
      phi2 = 0
    )
  }

  output <- stan_model$sample(
    data = data_list,
    init = init_fun,
    chains = N_CHAINS,
    parallel_chains = N_CHAINS,
    iter_warmup = N_WARMUP,
    iter_sampling = N_SAMPLES,
    refresh = 500,
    show_exceptions = FALSE,
    show_messages = TRUE
  )
  
  output$save_object(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_mosmgp-D2-Q1.RDS")))
  
} else {
  output <- readRDS(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_mosmgp-D2-Q1.RDS")))
}

format(finish_time <- Sys.time())
difftime(finish_time, start_time)  
```

# Results

```{r}
vars <- c("w", "mu", "Sigma", "theta", "phi")
output$summary(variables = vars, 
               posterior::default_convergence_measures())
```

```{r}
mcmc_trace(output$draws(vars))
```

```{r}
valid_chains <- c(1:4)
output_draws <- output$draws(variables = vars, format = "df") |> 
  subset_draws(chain = valid_chains)
output_draws_mat <- as.matrix(output_draws)
```

```{r}
posterior_means <- as.data.frame(output_draws) |> 
  select(matches(vars)) |> 
  colMeans()
posterior_means
```

```{r}
posterior_modes <- sapply(select(output_draws, matches(vars)), estimate_mode)
posterior_modes
```

```{r}
input_params
```


## Posterior Predictive Check

### Target locations

```{r}
n_star <- 100
ts1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 10, length.out = n_star)
ts2 <- ts1
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
# Draw posterior predictive samples using a particular posterior draw
r <- 1
this_w <- output_draws_mat[r, c("w[1]", "w[2]")]
this_Sigma <- output_draws_mat[r, c("Sigma[1]", "Sigma[2]")]
this_mu <- output_draws_mat[r, c("mu[1]", "mu[2]")]
this_theta <- output_draws_mat[r, c("theta[1]", "theta[2]")]
this_phi <- output_draws_mat[r, c("phi[1]", "phi[2]")]

this_post <- output_draws_mat[1,]

pp_draw <- pred_D2_Q1_draw(this_post, t1 = band1_df$t, t2 = band2_df$t, y1 = band1_df$y, y2 = band2_df$y, y1_se = band1_df$y_se, y2_se = band2_df$y_se, ts1 = ts1, ts2 = ts2)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pp_draw, aes(x = ts, y = fs, colour = factor(d))) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)), size = 1) 
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
pp_draws <- pred_D2_Q1(draws = output_draws_mat, 
                       t1 = band1_df$t, 
                       t2 = band2_df$t, 
                       y1 = band1_df$y, 
                       y2 = band2_df$y, 
                       y1_se = band1_df$y_se, 
                       y2_se = band2_df$y_se, 
                       ts1 = ts1, 
                       ts2 = ts2, 
                       n_draws = 1000)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pp_draws, aes(x = ts, y = fs, group = interaction(d,.draw), colour = factor(d))) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y), size = 1) 
```
